name: Believer’s Channel
body:
You received the blessing to manipulate life energy.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 13, Believer’s Boon, character level 7th, alignment must be within one step of your deity’s.

Benefit(s): You gain the ability to channel energy as a cleric of your character level –6 for a number of times per day equal to your Charisma modifier + 1.
